{{Top|leg}}
'''Mynos III''' was an astronomical object in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Greb Besrik]] may have once been [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a cell there.<ref name="LOTS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mynos III originated in the [[Canon|canon]] middle grade novel ''[[The High Republic: Beware the Nameless]]'',<ref name="Beware the Nameless">''[[The High Republic: Beware the Nameless]]''</ref> where it was a [[Planet|planet]] located in the [[Mynos system]] of the [[Dalchon sector]].<ref name="Beware the Nameless" /><ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Mynos system]]</ref> It was introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="LOTS"/>

During the storyline, if the player chooses to send [[Greb Besrik]] to a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] within their character's faction, they will receive an [[E-mail|email]] after the storyline from Besrik, who informs them of their situation within the prison. In the email, Besrik mentions [[Mearalis II/Legends|Mearalis II]] and Mynos III as possible locations for a cell in which he had been imprisoned in some time prior. Besrik also mentions that the place he was held in had many [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]],<ref name="LOTS"/> which may be a reference to Mynos III's status as an [[Farm|agricultural]] planet in the canon continuity.<ref name="Beware the Nameless" />
